# Generate all permutations of 6 integers from 0 to 5
perms = list(permutations(range(6)))

# Check each permutation to see if it forms a Costas array

    # Create a set to store the displacement vectors
    disp_vectors = set()
    
    # Calculate the displacement vectors
    for i in range(6):
        for j in range(i + 1, 6):
            dr = p[j] - p[i]
            dc = j - i
            disp_vectors.add((dr, dc))
    
    # If all displacement vectors are unique, print the permutation

else:
